# Parallax

> Parallax is a brand, product and frontend design studio in Bengaluru, India, working with companies in Bengaluru, Northeast India, Munich, Dubai and Denver. One team from identity to shipped code: brand systems, interface design, frontend engineering, design systems, digital strategy, motion.

Contact: projects@parallaxorg.com · https://www.linkedin.com/company/parallaxorg

## Markets

- [Northeast India](https://www.parallaxorg.com/northeast-india/): Brand systems, app design and frontend engineering for the companies and state governments of Northeast India.
- [Munich](https://www.parallaxorg.com/munich/): Brand systems, product UI and frontend engineering for Munich's startups, mobility, insurance and property companies — WCAG 2.1 AA and BFSG-ready. Every project is quoted after a scoping call.
- [Dubai](https://www.parallaxorg.com/dubai/): Bilingual Arabic–English brand systems, product UI and frontend engineering for Dubai's developers, hospitality groups, fintechs and founders — PDPL-ready. Every project is quoted after a scoping call.
- [Denver](https://www.parallaxorg.com/denver/): Brand systems, product UI and frontend engineering for Denver's startups, aerospace and outdoor brands — briefed at five, built overnight; ADA Title II and WCAG 2.1 AA by default. Every project is quoted after a scoping call.

## Questions each market page answers

### Northeast India (https://www.parallaxorg.com/northeast-india/)
- **Is Parallax a design agency in Northeast India?** Parallax is a brand, product and frontend design studio that builds the brands and apps the companies of Northeast India run on — for real-estate developers, hospitality groups, pharma companies, educational institutions and the state governments of the eight states. A lead based in the region runs workshops and reviews in person, and each project gets a dedicated team built out from our Northeast hub.
- **Do you design government portals and citizen services?** Yes. Parallax designs citizen service portals, tourism and permit systems, scheme and benefit tracking and internal dashboards for state departments, with accessibility audits to WCAG 2.1 AA and a design-system handover so the next vendor can continue the work.
- **How does a Bengaluru studio work with a client in Guwahati, Shillong or Imphal?** Our lead in the Northeast runs discovery, workshops and presentations on the ground, and the dedicated project team is built out from the Northeast hub — so reviews, workshops and calls happen in your hours, in your time zone. Discovery starts on a call or WhatsApp, and a visit is a planned trip, not a long-haul one.
- **How is a project priced?** Every project gets a fixed quote after a short scoping call, and we start by questioning the brief. Foundation (strategy, identity and a one-page launch site) and Studio (adding the website, product UI and frontend build) are the two most common engagements.
- **Which industries in Northeast India do you design for?** Four sectors sit at the centre of the practice: real estate, from launch sites to owner portals; hospitality and tourism, with direct booking and guest apps; pharma, with compliant product and partner interfaces; and education, with admission, learning and alumni platforms — plus the government band above.
- **How do I start a project with Parallax?** Email projects@parallaxorg.com or message the studio on WhatsApp with what you're building. Parallax starts by questioning the brief on one call, no deck. If it isn't the right studio for the work, it will say so and point you to one that is.
- Article: [Four cities, four broken products, and what we'd build instead](https://www.parallaxorg.com/articles/four-concepts-four-cities) — We picked the worst digital problem in each city we work in and designed the fix: off-plan buying, insurance forms, control rooms and admissions.
- Article: [Accessibility in Northeast India: the guidelines just became the law](https://www.parallaxorg.com/articles/accessibility-northeast-india) — India's accessibility guidelines are becoming mandatory: GIGW 3.0 for government, IS 17802 for everyone else, phased from 2026. What it means for the Northeast.

### Munich (https://www.parallaxorg.com/munich/)
- **Is Parallax a design agency in Munich?** Parallax is a brand, product and frontend design studio serving Munich, founded by a designer who trained in Munich. Each project gets a dedicated team built out from our Munich hub, with the lead on the ground for discovery, workshops and presentations. The studio builds brand systems, product interfaces and marketing sites for Munich's startups, mobility and industrial companies, insurers and property developers.
- **Do you work in German?** Discovery and presentations are run in English today, and in German as Munich-based leads join the studio's network. German UI copy, documentation and the Barrierefreiheitserklärung are produced with native German speakers; design files and code are delivered in English.
- **Is your work BFSG-compliant?** Yes. Since 28 June 2025 the Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz requires consumer websites, apps, shops and banking services to meet WCAG 2.1 AA, with fines up to €100,000 and competitor Abmahnungen. Parallax measures every page it ships against AA and audits, remediates and documents existing products to the same standard.
- **How is a project priced?** Every project gets a fixed quote after a short scoping call, with no rate card and no hourly billing. Scope is set by the number of touchpoints, pages or screens, and the timeline. Foundation covers written strategy, a full identity system, a brand toolkit and a one-page launch site; Studio adds the website, product UX and UI, a design system and the frontend build. Payment is split by milestone: 50/50 for Foundation, 40/40/20 for Studio. You work with a senior Munich lead and one integrated team, which is what keeps delivery fast.
- **Which industries in Munich do you design for?** Four sectors sit at the centre of the Munich practice: startups and scale-ups that need a brand system and product UI before the next round; mobility and industrial companies with configurators and engineering tools; insurance and finance onboarding that customers finish; and real-estate and proptech portals for owners, tenants and managers.
- **How does a studio in Bengaluru work with a Munich team?** The dedicated project team is built out from the Munich hub and works in your hours, with the lead on the ground for reviews and workshops; the studio continues after you log off, so the next iteration is ready the following morning. 09:00 in Munich is 12:30 in Bengaluru, so the two working days overlap until the German evening.
- Article: [Four cities, four broken products, and what we'd build instead](https://www.parallaxorg.com/articles/four-concepts-four-cities) — We picked the worst digital problem in each city we work in and designed the fix: off-plan buying, insurance forms, control rooms and admissions.
- Article: [BFSG in Munich: who it covers, what it costs, and what to fix first](https://www.parallaxorg.com/articles/bfsg-munich) — Germany's Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz has applied since 28 June 2025: WCAG 2.1 AA for consumer sites, apps and shops, fines to €100,000. What to fix first.

### Dubai (https://www.parallaxorg.com/dubai/)
- **Is Parallax a design agency in Dubai?** Parallax is a brand, product and frontend design studio working in Dubai, with two of its own people already in Dubai. Each project gets a dedicated team built out from our Dubai hub, with the lead on the ground to run discovery, presentations and the relationship. The studio builds bilingual Arabic–English brand systems, product interfaces and marketing sites for developers, hospitality groups, fintechs and founders.
- **Do you design in Arabic and English?** Yes. Parallax designs bilingual from the first screen: one component library in two directions, layouts mirrored rather than flipped, Arabic typography set to sit with the Latin, and right-to-left tested on real devices. Arabic localisation is priced on top of the published tiers.
- **How is a project priced?** Every project gets a fixed quote after a short scoping call, with no rate card and no hourly billing. Scope is set by the number of touchpoints, pages or screens, and the timeline. Foundation covers written strategy, a full identity system, a brand toolkit and a one-page launch site; Studio adds the website, product UX and UI, a design system and the frontend build. Payment is split by milestone: 50/50 for Foundation, 40/40/20 for Studio. Bilingual Arabic scope is quoted on top.
- **Are your products PDPL-compliant and accessible?** Parallax designs consent, records of processing and breach paths into the product under the UAE Personal Data Protection Law, and measures every page against WCAG 2.1 AA, the TDRA policy and the Dubai Universal Design Code. UAE Pass and Dubai Now integration are wired on the front end the customer sees.
- **Which industries in Dubai do you design for?** Four sectors sit at the centre of the Dubai practice: real estate and proptech, from off-plan launch sites to owner portals; hospitality and tourism, with direct booking engines and guest apps; fintech onboarding and KYC flows people finish; and founders and trade — brands, storefronts and B2B ordering portals for new licences.
- **How do I start a project with Parallax in Dubai?** Email projects@parallaxorg.com or open a WhatsApp thread with what you're building. The studio starts by questioning the brief on one call, no deck, and someone from the studio can be in a room in Dubai within the week. The dedicated project team is built out from the Dubai hub and works in your hours; 09:00 in Dubai is 10:30 in Bengaluru, so the whole working day overlaps.
- Article: [Four cities, four broken products, and what we'd build instead](https://www.parallaxorg.com/articles/four-concepts-four-cities) — We picked the worst digital problem in each city we work in and designed the fix: off-plan buying, insurance forms, control rooms and admissions.
- Article: [PDPL in Dubai: what's law now, what's waiting on the regulations, and what to design in](https://www.parallaxorg.com/articles/pdpl-dubai) — The UAE's PDPL has been law since 2022; its fines wait on Executive Regulations, while DIFC and ADGM already enforce theirs. What to design in before the clock starts.

### Denver (https://www.parallaxorg.com/denver/)
- **Is Parallax a design agency in Denver?** Parallax is a brand, product and frontend design studio serving Denver on a follow-the-sun cycle. Each project gets a dedicated team built out from our Denver hub, with a lead on the ground for discovery, workshops and presentations in Mountain time. The studio builds brand systems, product interfaces and marketing sites for Denver's startups, aerospace and energy companies, outdoor brands and real-estate developers.
- **How does a studio in Bengaluru work with a Denver team?** Denver runs on a follow-the-sun cycle: 09:00 in Denver is 20:30 in Bengaluru, so a brief sent at five is built overnight and waiting at eight the next morning. Discovery, workshops and reviews happen in Mountain time with the lead on the ground in Denver, and the dedicated team is built out from the Denver hub; design and engineering continue overnight so the work is waiting at eight.
- **How is a project priced?** Every project gets a fixed quote after a short scoping call, with no rate card and no hourly billing. Scope is set by the number of touchpoints, pages or screens, and the timeline. Foundation covers written strategy, a full identity system, a brand toolkit and a one-page launch site; Studio adds the website, product UX and UI, a design system and the frontend build. Payment is split by milestone: 50/50 for Foundation, 40/40/20 for Studio. You work with a senior local lead and one integrated team, briefed at five and built overnight.
- **Do you build websites that meet ADA Title II and Colorado HB21-1110?** Yes. Every page Parallax ships is measured against WCAG 2.1 AA, the standard both the ADA Title II web rule (26 April 2027 for most public entities) and Colorado's HB21-1110 (in force since 1 July 2025) require. The studio also audits and remediates existing sites and hands over the conformance documentation a procurement office asks for.
- **Which industries in Denver do you design for?** Four sectors sit at the centre of the Denver practice: startups and scale-ups that need a brand system and product UI before the next round; aerospace, energy and industrial companies with internal tools that were never designed; outdoor and consumer brands where taste is the buying criterion; and real-estate and proptech portals that move inventory.
- **How do I start a project with Parallax in Denver?** Email projects@parallaxorg.com with what you're building. The studio starts by questioning the brief on one call — no deck — and answers in your afternoon with the first response in your inbox the next morning. If Parallax isn't the right studio for the work, it will say so and point you to one that is.
- Article: [Four cities, four broken products, and what we'd build instead](https://www.parallaxorg.com/articles/four-concepts-four-cities) — We picked the worst digital problem in each city we work in and designed the fix: off-plan buying, insurance forms, control rooms and admissions.
- Article: [ADA Title II in Colorado: the deadlines, the standard, and what to fix first](https://www.parallaxorg.com/articles/ada-title-ii-colorado) — The DOJ's Title II web rule lands 26 April 2027 for most Colorado entities; HB21-1110 already applies. What WCAG 2.1 AA means and what to fix first.

## Concept projects

Unbranded concepts: how Parallax would solve the most pressing product problem in each market. Outcomes are design targets, not client results.

- [Sold before it's built. — Dubai real estate concept](https://www.parallaxorg.com/work/concept-off-plan-dubai) — A concept for Dubai's off-plan buyers: live inventory, payment milestones and construction progress in one app, from launch day to handover.
- [Insurance people finish. — Munich insurance concept](https://www.parallaxorg.com/work/concept-insurance-munich) — A concept for insurance onboarding and claims in Munich: a flow customers finish, built to WCAG 2.2 AA for the BFSG.
- [Tools that match the hardware. — Denver energy concept](https://www.parallaxorg.com/work/concept-energy-ops-denver) — A concept for a renewable fleet's control room: alarms ranked by consequence, one view of every asset, and shift handover built in.
- [Admissions students don't fight. — Northeast India education concept](https://www.parallaxorg.com/work/concept-admissions-northeast) — A concept for university admissions in Northeast India: a phone-first flow that survives a weak signal, saves every step and reports status by SMS.
